context_requirements: P-selectin (SELP) expression, which is largely restricted to activated endothelial cells and platelets
Presence of a functional inflammatory or thrombotic signalling context; none of the nine cell lines are endothelial or platelet lineage
SELP transcript must be present for a small-molecule inhibitor to engage the target
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Enrichment of leukocyte adhesion, coagulation, or platelet activation transcriptional programmes after treatment
Any line showing a magnitude above 'none' at either time point

evidence.supports: P-selectin expression is induced in endothelial cells during inflammation and is not a general feature of the epithelial, mesenchymal, hepatic, or prostate carcinoma lines used here
